# Quantum ESPRESSO fixtures

`si.in`/`si.out` (SCF), `si_relax.in`/`si_relax.out` (`relax`, converged) and
`si_relax_nstep.in`/`si_relax_nstep.out` (`relax` stopped by `nstep = 2`) are
Quantum ESPRESSO 7.5 `pw.x` inputs and program output of diamond-silicon runs
generated by the *httk* project, copied unmodified from
`httk-workflow-qe/tests/data`. The GPL pseudopotential those runs used is not
included.
